gloss: to fit into; to get stuck; to become addicted

definitions.gloss: to fit into; to go into
definitions.explanation: For something to fit precisely into a space or opening.

definitions.gloss: to get stuck; to fall into
definitions.explanation: To fall into a trap, hole, or difficult situation.

definitions.gloss: to be addicted; to be into
definitions.explanation: To become deeply absorbed in a hobby or activity.

examples.japanese: パズルのピースがぴったり{嵌|は}まった。
{泥|どろ}{沼|ぬま}に{嵌|は}まってしまった。
examples.english: I got stuck in a muddy swamp.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、ゲームに{嵌|は}まっている。
examples.english: I've been really into games lately.

notes:
{嵌|は}まる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) with both literal and figurative meanings.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: {嵌|は}める (to fit, to trap)
- {嵌|は}まる: The piece fits.
- {嵌|は}める: I fit the piece in.

ASPECT (ている):
{嵌|は}まっている indicates a state of being stuck, fitted, or addicted.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]が[space]に{嵌|は}まる — [thing] fits into [space]
- [person]が[trap]に{嵌|は}まる — [person] falls into [trap]
- [person]が[hobby]に{嵌|は}まる — [person] is into [hobby]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {穴|あな}に{嵌|は}まる (fall into a hole)
- {罠|わな}に{嵌|は}まる (fall into a trap)
- ドラマに{嵌|は}まる (be hooked on a drama)
- ツボに{嵌|は}まる (hit the spot, be exactly right)

COLLOQUIAL:
{嵌|は}まる is very common in casual speech for being absorbed in hobbies: ゲームに{嵌|は}まっている (I'm really into games).
